mostWorthwhile.text: Following the dusty gas into the smaller knot was most worthwhile: it connected the turning gas to a star and an unfinished disk.

leastWorthwhile.text: The large-gathering action was the less compelling of the two, although its explanation of contraction and fusion was informative.

surprise.text: I was interested that young stars shine from contraction before sustained fusion begins.

arbitrary.text: Neither chosen action felt arbitrary; both directly addressed a stated goal.

continue.text: Yes. The unfinished dusty disk makes me curious about what happens to the material that did not become part of the star.
